# VS Code theme coverage

Fovea's VS Code themes are checked against the [theme color reference](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-docs/blob/f7ee5a5c642aee433e093d8d10a9c056770c77e3/api/references/theme-color.md)
as of VS Code 1.142 (vscode-docs commit f7ee5a5),
pinned in [`fixtures/vscode/theme-color-keys.json`](../../fixtures/vscode/theme-color-keys.json).
The mapping is in [`packages/build/src/vscode/colors.ts`](../../packages/build/src/vscode/colors.ts).

- **Keys in the reference:** 971
- **Set by Fovea:** 950
- **Left to VS Code's defaults on purpose:** 21 (reasons below)
- **Neither:** 0
- **Set but not in the reference:** 0

## Left to VS Code's defaults

High-contrast themes only. VS Code leaves them unset in light and dark themes.

- `contrastActiveBorder`
- `contrastBorder`

Outline variants that VS Code only draws in high-contrast themes by default. Fovea marks these states with fills, squiggles or the muted text color.

- `toolbar.hoverOutline`
- `editorError.border`
- `editorWarning.border`
- `editorInfo.border`
- `editorHint.border`
- `editorUnnecessaryCode.border`
- `editorGhostText.border`
- `diffEditor.insertedTextBorder`
- `diffEditor.removedTextBorder`
- `peekViewEditor.matchHighlightBorder`

Left unset so text keeps its syntax or ANSI color. The contrast budget checks every token color on the selection, find and bracket highlights.

- `editor.selectionForeground`
- `editor.findMatchForeground`
- `editor.findMatchHighlightForeground`
- `editorBracketMatch.foreground`
- `terminal.selectionForeground`

Opacities expressed as colors, not colors. VS Code's defaults apply.

- `editorUnnecessaryCode.opacity`
- `minimap.foregroundOpacity`

No border around the window, as in VS Code's own light and dark themes.

- `window.activeBorder`
- `window.inactiveBorder`

## Contrast of workbench text and marks

VS Code paints it on. Translucent layers are flattened in order. The bands come from
[`budget.ts`](../../packages/palette/src/budget.ts); ✕ marks a failure.

## Code on highlight backgrounds

Backgrounds that code can sit on, beyond the palette overlays that
[`docs/design.md`](../design.md) covers. Each cell is the token color with the lowest contrast
there; every token color must reach the token-on-highlight band
(≥ 60, 4.5:1).
